messages:
Maya Chen: Need a compact asset bundle for the 'Serving Economics' launch (webinar + benchmark drop). Ask: one-pager PDF, 3 social cards, webinar/email hero, a small latency vs cost microdiagram, and a single routing slide for inbound leads. Deadline: EOD Thursday. Can design pick this up? cc @Jordan @Sam @Elaine

Jordan Patel: We can take it. Quick clarifying q's: full brand colors or muted palette for diagrams? One-pager: single-column or modular tiles?

Sam Gupta: For routing slide, we need UTMs and a hidden form field source=serving-econ. Also confirm MQL logic: is webinar signup enough or require demo request? cc @Brandon Li for legal/data

Elaine Ho: I'll set up a Figma file with tokenized components (hero, microtile, diagram, routing slide). Brand rule: primary palette + icon set only, no custom gradients. Guardrails: https://redwood.design/brand/guardrails

design-bot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/def456/serving-econ-assets (auto)

Jordan Patel: Uploaded first mockups and sizes:
- Hero: 1200x628
- Social cards: 1080x1080 (3 variants)
- Microtile: 600x600
- One-pager: US Letter (PDF) + 800px web export
- Routing slide: 1920x1080 (ppt export)

Jordan Patel: Microdiagram options: A) compact XY chart (latency x, unit cost y) with callouts B) Sankey flow (tokens -> compute -> cost). Thoughts?

Maya Chen: Prioritize email hero and the XY microdiagram for socials; use Sankey on the one-pager. For copy, two short headlines: 'Serving economics that scale' and 'Lower cost, same quality'

Sam Gupta: Routing plan: inbound@redwood.com -> SDR queue -> tag product_interest=serving-econ. UTMs: utm_campaign=serving-econ&utm_source=social. Hidden input `source=serving-econ`. MQL: demo_request=true OR company_size>=50.

Brandon Li: Legal note: add explicit opt-in checkbox on registration: 'I agree to receive communications from Redwood Inference.' Avoid collecting job title unless user opts in. No other blockers.

Jordan Patel: Updated Figma with opt-in checkbox and muted-palette microdiagram variant (better on mobile). Need 30-min review tomorrow 2:00pm to lock copy and exports. Please flag accessibility (contrast, alt text) in Figma comments.

Maya Chen: 2:00pm review confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
